messages:
mira: Heads-up — AcmeHealth flagged lack of per-route cost breakdown + missing trace hooks for high-latency tails. They want a deliverable we can show them by EOW next sprint. Can we align on what to ship for Q2?

alex: we should split into 2 phased asks: 1) quick per-route cost widget + export, 2) tracing hook surface for long-tail latency. Phase 1 could be low-effort.

dan: agree. Phase 1 = dashboards + export. Phase 2 = trace hooks + sampling adjustments. Need SLOs/acceptance criteria for both.

jen: for acceptance, propose: cost widget shows per-route p50/p95 cost delta week-over-week; export CSV & JSON; and an internal alert if cost-per-inference > X for 3 consecutive mins. :thumbsup:

sam: for traces: minimal surface is a hook to attach span metadata (model version, routing tier, batch size). Also need a lightweight sampling toggle per-customer. Otherwise trace volume explodes.

mira: +1. AcmeHealth specifically wants model-version attached and ability to filter traces by routing policy. We should confirm sampling defaults for enterprise.

alex: constraints: infra can support per-route cost compute if we reuse existing billing-attribution pipeline. Estimated 2 dev-weeks for dashboard + export if we scope to top 100 routes.

dan: tracing work touches runtime. I estimate 3–4 dev-weeks for the hook + safe sampling toggle + tests. We'll need a canary in sandbox.

jen: launch criteria suggestion: 
- Dashboard: per-route cost + export + doc + 2 customer QA sessions.
- Tracing: hook + sampling toggle + retention policy defined + internal canary.

mira: good. What's the minimal MVP for customer demo by EOW sprint?

alex: MVP demo = dashboard with per-route cost and a link to filtered traces (even if trace hook is only internal for demo). That buys time for full hook rollout.

sam: for demo, we can stub model-version on a few routes to show filtering. But call it out as "demo data" in notes.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: patch/obs-cost-widget v0.3 -> staging at 2025-06-12T15:02:10Z

dan: we should add gating: no elevated token costs in staging. Run a 2h load test with sampling set to 0.1 first.

mira: action items:
- alex: scope dashboard to top 100 routes + export (owner) — due 2025-06-20
- dan: implement trace hook and sampling toggle (owner) — initial canary by 2025-07-03
- jen: draft launch acceptance criteria + runbook (owner) — due 2025-06-18
- sam: prepare demo data & run sandbox canary (owner) — due 2025-06-22

alex: linking a quick config snippet for sampling we discussed:
```
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.05
  enterprise_overrides:
    AcmeHealth: 0.25
  route_overrides: {}
```

jen: also documenting privacy note: traces may contain PII depending on prompt content. Need a redaction note and opt-out option for enterprise demos. Add to runbook.

mira: agreed — include KMS checklist + redaction in runbook.

sam: FYI AcmeHealth product lead said they can demo internally if we get dashboard + basic trace filter. That buys us the hook rollout time.

dan: schedule a 30m sync with infra and runtime next Tue to assess perf risk (I can set invite).

mira: thanks. Can everyone react with :eyes: when they ack their action items?

alex: :eyes:

jen: :eyes:

sam: :eyes:

ops-bot: reminder: weekly-observability-standup in 2 days

mira: closing notes — we'll iterate on scope if perf or cost surprises come up. Keeping demo promise is priority."
